primary_review.rationale: Complete review of all 343 source lines found one external interaction: an Ether transfer to msg.sender after the caller's dividend and referral state is updated. Solidity transfer reverts on failure and is not an unchecked boolean-returning send or raw low-level call. No call, callcode, delegatecall, staticcall, send, assembly call, dynamic typed callback, contract creation, or selfdestruct exists. Other-class reentrancy tool findings do not contradict this class-specific absence conclusion.

evidence.summary: Whole-file review found only a reverting Ether transfer and no raw, unchecked, or unknown-target low-level call behavior.
Slither 0.11.5 with solc 0.4.25 found no low-level or unchecked-send finding; two reported findings are scoped to Reentrancy.
Recovered project evidence classifies transfer-only behavior as a false-positive root cause rather than CallToUnknown truth.

representation_limitations: The selected token windows omit the Ether-transfer source site and retain only 33.87967964239151 percent of unique code tokens.
All 30 v9 EXTERNAL_CALL edges are same-file SafeMath LibraryCall nodes; the real Ether Transfer node has no type-11 edge.
R4-GAP-008 governs the resulting representation-semantic defect; graph signal was not used as negative truth.
